[[File:FeatherDuster.png|thumb|right|250px|A Feather Duster]]
A '''Feather Duster''', as the name implies, was a tool used for cleaning up dust. It was constructed from the feathers of various birds.<ref name="SWG:AFD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|A Feather Duster}}</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a Feather Duster was awarded by [[Yawse Felsiy]] to an anonymous [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who helped clean up the various [[dust durni]]s that had invaded the [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]]. Ironically, a Feather Duster was awarded to yet another spacer for performing the same task on [[Nova Orion Station]].<ref name="SWG:DD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Dust Durni}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Feather Duster appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AFD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Feather Duster was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|Chapter 8]]" on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>

The Feather Duster was as a reward item for completing the "[[W:c:swg:Dust Durni|Dust Durni]]" collection. Within the game, this collection was completable in two separate locations. On Tansarii Point Station, it was used to familiarize the player with the collections system.<ref name="SWG:DD" /> The Feather Duster could be equipped by the player, or used in their house as decoration.<ref name="SWG:AFD" />
